data.name: EvapRun
data.value: Mode 08 — EVAP

data.name: EvapVinRequired
data.value: Enter the documented 17-character VIN of the vehicle to test.

data.name: EvapWarning
data.value: This operation requests the ECU to establish the conditions for an evaporative-system leak test; it does not itself perform the leak test. Follow the manufacturer's procedure, ensure the vehicle is stationary, engine stopped, in a ventilated area and safe to test. The ECU may refuse the test. Do not repeat it automatically.

data.name: EvapConfirm
data.value: Request EVAP test conditions once on VIN {0}, physical CAN {1}/{2}?

data.name: EvapRunning
data.value: EVAP precondition checks in progress.

data.name: EvapExpired
data.value: Authorization expired; test state may be uncertain. Do not repeat automatically.

data.name: EvapNotCompletion
data.value: An acknowledgment does not prove completion or a leak-test result.

data.name: EvapOutcome_ACKNOWLEDGED
data.value: ECU acknowledged the test request.

data.name: EvapOutcome_REFUSED
data.value: ECU refused the test request.

data.name: EvapOutcome_UNCERTAIN
data.value: Test request state uncertain — do not repeat automatically.

data.name: EvapOutcome_NOT_TESTED
data.value: Preconditions not verified; no test request sent.

data.name: ClearRun
data.value: Mode 04 — emissions DTC reset

data.name: ClearVinRequired
data.value: Enter the documented 17-character VIN of the vehicle to test.

data.name: ClearWarning
data.value: This reset can erase emissions faults, freeze-frame data and readiness information. Export the original evidence first. Follow the manufacturer's procedure with vehicle stationary and engine stopped. Never use this test to conceal an unresolved fault. No automatic retry.

data.name: ClearConfirm
data.value: Request a single emissions diagnostic reset on VIN {0}, physical CAN {1}/{2}?

data.name: ClearRunning
data.value: Recording pre-reset evidence and checking conditions.

data.name: ClearExpired
data.value: Authorization expired. Reset state may be uncertain; do not repeat automatically.

data.name: ClearNotCompletion
data.value: Permanent DTCs are observed, never assumed erased. An ACK does not prove all ECU faults are absent.

data.name: ClearOutcome_ACKNOWLEDGED_READBACK
data.value: Reset acknowledged; confirmed and pending DTC modes reread.

data.name: ClearOutcome_ACKNOWLEDGED_PARTIAL
data.value: Reset acknowledged; readback incomplete.

data.name: ClearOutcome_REFUSED
data.value: Reset request refused by ECU.

data.name: ClearOutcome_UNCERTAIN
data.value: Reset state uncertain — do not repeat automatically.

data.name: ClearOutcome_NOT_TESTED
data.value: Conditions not verified; no reset request attempted.
